name: auryn-ci
summary: CI plugin for Auryn (deployment & infrastructure tier, ADR 0007). Parses GitHub Actions workflows (.github/workflows/*.yml) into a Resource (the pipeline) that BUILDS_IMAGE the shared Image hub for each image its steps build or push (docker/build-push-action tags, docker build -t / docker push). That edge flips a hub image resolved/internal, closing the build->image->run loop the docker producer defers to CI. A deploy-ci enrichment runs the shared image lifecycle. Depends on auryn-core and PyYAML.
